items.label: Center of intelligence
items.value: Mental (Head).

items.label: Direction of use
items.value: Outward: uses the mind to observe/understand the world in order to protect against intrusion.

items.label: Core issue
items.value: Anxiety and a feeling of lacking the resources to meet the demands of the world.

sections.title: Ego dynamics
sections.desc: Compulsion, passion, fixation, defense, ego pride, fear, desire.

items.label: Compulsion (Avoidance)
items.value: Avoiding inner emptiness at all costs.

items.label: Passion (Vice)
items.value: Avarice: conserving energy, time and knowledge.

items.label: Fixation
items.value: Stinginess (detachment): emotional distance, staying a spectator rather than an actor.

items.label: Defense mechanism
items.value: Isolation / compartmentalization: separating ideas and feelings, isolating areas of life to avoid being overwhelmed.

items.label: Ego pride
items.value: I know; I understand.

items.label: Basic fear
items.value: Being helpless, useless, incapable or overwhelmed by the world.

items.label: Basic desire
items.value: Being capable and competent.

children.label: Self-preservation
children.value: Castle (Refuge): withdraws into a protected space to conserve their resources.

children.label: Social
children.value: Totem (Specialist): becoming a recognized expert within an intellectual elite/hierarchy.

children.label: One-to-one (Sexual)
children.value: Confidence (Trust): a secret, absolute connection with one person, sharing their inner world.

items.label: Social style
items.value: Withdrawn: withdraws to protect their integrity and process information.

items.label: Conflict management
items.value: Competency: stays objective, relies on facts rather than feelings.

items.label: Wings
items.value: Wing 4 (more emotional/creative) and wing 6 (more analytical/loyal).

items.label: Integration (Growth)
items.value: → 8: becomes embodied, direct action, confident assertiveness.

items.label: Disintegration (Stress)
items.value: → 7: agitation, scattering, hyperactivity, distractions to flee anxiety.

sections.title: Spiritual identity and core
sections.desc: Holy Idea, virtue, aspect, core, child of the soul.

items.label: Holy Idea
items.value: Holy Omniscience / Holy Transparency: perceiving the total interconnection of reality.

items.label: Virtue
items.value: Non-attachment: presence without clinging out of fear.

items.label: Idealized aspect
items.value: Diamond Guidance: the essential intellect that discerns the objective truth of experience.

children.label: Specific difficulty
children.value: Deficient isolation: feeling small, empty and impoverished.

children.label: Specific illusion
children.value: Separation: believing oneself to be an isolated, independent entity.

items.label: Child of the soul
items.value: The inner Little 8: vigor/activity repressed in favor of intellectual withdrawal.

items.label: Speaking style
items.value: Treatise / dissertations: structured, factual, often lengthy on their areas of expertise.

items.label: Communication miscommunication
items.value: Truth-Obscurity: precision perceived as cold, confusing or distant.

items.label: Warning signs
items.value: Cutting off from physical needs, social isolation, abstract theories disconnected from reality.

items.label: Growth practices
items.value: Coming back into the body, sharing their knowledge, tolerating emotions in real time, daring to act without waiting for all the facts.

items.label: Frequent mix-ups
items.value: 4 (depth), 9 (apparent calm), 1 (analytical/perfectionistic).

children.label: In love
children.value: Loyal but needs autonomy; often communicates better nonverbally.

children.label: At work
children.value: A valuable expert, calm in a crisis; may seem inaccessible or slow to act due to over-preparation.

levels.text: Visionary: clarity and creativity in service of reality.
Perceptive observer: sharp analysis, open curiosity.
Studious expert: accumulation, specialization, increased withdrawal.
Intense conceptualizer: mentalizing, emotional distance, isolation.
Provocative cynic: hard detachment, sarcasm, defensive contempt.
Isolated nihilist: loss of meaning, extreme withdrawal.
Terrified alien: raw anxiety, the world experienced as intrusive and threatening.
Imploded schizoid: collapse, shutting down, breaking off connection.

items.label: Awareness
items.value: Moving from the trance of mental withdrawal to self-remembering and presence in the moment.

items.label: Spiral Dynamics
items.value: ORANGE (rationality/expertise) and YELLOW (systemic thinking/complexity).

items.label: Analogy
items.value: A remote-control station / fortress: watches the battle from afar, from its tower, so as not to be worn out by direct combat.
